audience: First-time visitors using a fictional park guide
fact_packet: 青岚步道导览提供离线地图。游客首次联网下载的地图包为48 MB，包含路线、路口照片和文字说明，不含实时封路消息。已经下载的地图在断网后仍能打开；手机定位权限未开启时，游客仍可查看地图，但不会显示自己的位置。地图包更新后，应用会在下次联网时提示用户确认下载，不会自动替换旧包。确认更新失败时，旧包仍可用。封路消息只在联网时刷新，每条消息显示最近获取时间；旧消息未更新不等于道路已经开放。管理方建议出发前查看现场公告，离线导览不能替代现场指示。
instruction_text: Explain how the fictional trail guide works before and after the phone loses its connection. Write one self-contained Chinese passage without a title. Cover all supplied behavior and limits.
intended_voice: Patient, concrete, and conversational without sales language
read_only_context: All names, organizations, measurements, dates, and events in this task are fictional project-constructed material. Write within that fictional scenario. No external knowledge, additional evidence, or personal experience is supplied. Every listed fact is in scope for the passage.

required_facts.statement: The initial online map download is 48 MB and includes routes, junction photos, and text, but no live closure information.
A downloaded map remains available offline; without location permission it remains readable but does not show the user location.
An update requires confirmation on the next connection and does not automatically replace the old package.
A failed confirmed update leaves the old package usable.
Closure messages refresh only online and show their last retrieval time; an unrefreshed message is not evidence that a road reopened.
The manager recommends checking the on-site notice before departure; the guide does not replace on-site directions.

audience: Community garden volunteers reading a simple sensor panel
fact_packet: 槐园雨量板每10分钟记录一次该时段的降雨量，单位为毫米。页面上的日累计是当天已收到记录的和，不是这些记录的平均值。例如连续3个时段分别记录0、2、1毫米，累计为3毫米。设备暂时断线时，相应位置显示“缺测”，不能把它当作0毫米。当天有缺测时，累计数字旁会出现“记录不完整”。重新联网后，设备最多补传最近24小时保存在本机的记录；补传后累计可能增加。补传不代表那一刻突然下雨。板上的记录只反映菜园入口附近这一台仪器，不能直接代表整片街区的降雨。
instruction_text: Explain the fictional rain panel so a volunteer can interpret a daily total and the missing-data marker. Use the supplied arithmetic example and retain its limits. Write connected Chinese prose without a title.
intended_voice: Clear and matter-of-fact, with explicit distinctions
read_only_context: All names, organizations, measurements, dates, and events in this task are fictional project-constructed material. Write within that fictional scenario. No external knowledge, additional evidence, or personal experience is supplied. Every listed fact is in scope for the passage.

required_facts.statement: The panel records the rainfall within each 10-minute interval in millimeters.
The displayed daily accumulation is the sum of received intervals, not their average; intervals of 0, 2, and 1 mm sum to 3 mm.
A disconnected interval is marked missing and must not be treated as zero.
Any missing interval causes an incomplete-record marker beside the daily total.
Reconnection can upload at most the previous 24 hours stored locally; a higher total after upload is not evidence of rain at that moment.
The single instrument measures near the garden entrance, not necessarily the whole neighborhood.

topic: Rain gauge totals and missing readings

audience: New members of a fictional design documentation team
fact_packet: 星桥资料库把已经发布的设计说明加入搜索索引，草稿不进入索引。索引每天02:00更新一次，因此当天新发布的说明可能已经能用链接打开，却还搜不到。标题完全匹配的结果排在正文匹配的结果前面，同一档内按最后修改时间从新到旧排列。排在前面不表示内容已经得到更多审核。结果卡片上的摘要来自上次索引时的正文，打开文档才会看到当前版本。归档文档仍可被搜索到，但卡片会标出“已归档”。团队要求引用操作流程前检查文档内的适用版本；搜索页不替读者判断流程是否适用于手头项目。
instruction_text: Explain why a document may open by link before it appears in search, and how readers should interpret ranking. Write a complete Chinese explanation with no title, covering the supplied system behavior.
intended_voice: Practical, precise, and reassuring without overpromising
read_only_context: All names, organizations, measurements, dates, and events in this task are fictional project-constructed material. Write within that fictional scenario. No external knowledge, additional evidence, or personal experience is supplied. Every listed fact is in scope for the passage.

required_facts.statement: Only published design notes enter the search index; drafts do not.
The index updates daily at 02:00, so a newly published page can be reachable by link before it is searchable.
Exact title matches precede body matches; each tier sorts by last modification time, newest first.
A higher rank does not indicate more review.
The search snippet comes from the last indexed body, whereas opening the document shows the current version.
Archived documents remain searchable and are labeled archived.
Before citing a procedure, readers must check its applicable version in the document; search does not decide project applicability.

audience: Visitors to a fictional everyday-materials workshop
fact_packet: 木禾工坊比较了同系列的单层杯和双层杯。双层杯的两层杯壁之间封着空气，这层空气能减慢经杯壁传出的热量，但不能阻止所有散热。演示时，两只杯子各装200毫升70摄氏度的水，都不加盖，放在同一张桌上。20分钟后，单层杯测得49摄氏度，双层杯测得56摄氏度。这里只做了1次演示，没有重复测量。主持人据此说，在这次条件下，双层杯中的水降温较慢；他没有承诺日常每次都会相差7摄氏度。实验没有比较杯子加盖后的表现，也没有测试耐摔性。
instruction_text: Explain what the fictional mug demonstration shows and what it does not show. Integrate the supplied mechanism, measurements, and caveats in one Chinese passage without a title.
intended_voice: Accessible and curious, with careful separation of measurement and explanation
read_only_context: All names, organizations, measurements, dates, and events in this task are fictional project-constructed material. Write within that fictional scenario. No external knowledge, additional evidence, or personal experience is supplied. Every listed fact is in scope for the passage.

required_facts.statement: Air enclosed between the two walls slows heat transfer through the wall but does not prevent all heat loss.
Both mugs were from the same series, each held 200 mL of water initially at 70 degrees Celsius, had no lid, and stood on the same table.
After 20 minutes, the single-wall mug measured 49 degrees Celsius and the double-wall mug 56 degrees Celsius.
There was only one demonstration and no repeated measurement.
The presenter limited the slower-cooling conclusion to these conditions and did not promise a 7-degree everyday difference.
Lidded performance and drop resistance were not tested.

audience: Beginners preparing a fictional craft-process video
fact_packet: 纸舟影像课用延时摄影记录一幅拼贴画的制作。相机每5秒拍1张，共拍360张；这360张照片按每秒30张播放，成片长12秒。拍摄间隔决定采样有多密，播放帧率决定已有照片播放得多快，两者不是同一个设置。把已有照片改成每秒15张播放，成片会变成24秒，但不会补回拍摄间隔里没有记录的动作。演示中，相机位置和灯光保持不变。讲师建议要展示快速翻折纸张的细节时缩短拍摄间隔，但本次没有给出通用的最佳间隔。最终视频没有录制现场声音。
instruction_text: Explain the relationship between capture interval, playback rate, and visible detail in the supplied time-lapse setup. Keep the arithmetic tied to the fictional example. Write one Chinese passage without a title.
intended_voice: Friendly and explanatory, avoiding technical grandiosity
read_only_context: All names, organizations, measurements, dates, and events in this task are fictional project-constructed material. Write within that fictional scenario. No external knowledge, additional evidence, or personal experience is supplied. Every listed fact is in scope for the passage.

required_facts.statement: The collage demonstration captures one image every 5 seconds for 360 images.
Playing 360 images at 30 images per second produces 12 seconds of video.
Capture interval controls sampling density and playback rate controls playback speed; they are separate settings.
At 15 images per second the same images produce 24 seconds, without recovering uncaptured motion.
Camera position and lighting remain fixed in the demonstration.
The instructor recommends a shorter interval for fast paper folds but supplies no universal best interval.
The final video contains no recorded on-site sound.

audience: Non-specialist volunteers preparing a fictional exhibition booklet
fact_packet: 苇岸展册先在屏幕上排版，再用指定的米白色纸张试印。屏幕发光，纸张靠反射环境光呈现颜色，因此同一张图在两者上不一定看起来一样。印厂提供的软打样设置用于预览指定纸张的大致颜色变化，不能替代纸样。团队此次在同一盏检查灯下比较2张纸样，只调整封面的蓝色，没有提高图片分辨率。获确认的纸样标为B版；这个确认只针对颜色和版面，不包括尚未校对的人名。若更换纸张，团队要重新确认纸样，不能把B版的确认直接沿用。此次流程没有测量观众在不同光线下的感受。
instruction_text: Explain why the supplied proofing workflow includes a paper sample and what approval covers. Use only these fictional production facts. Write a self-contained Chinese passage without a title.
intended_voice: Calm, concrete, and attentive to expectations
read_only_context: All names, organizations, measurements, dates, and events in this task are fictional project-constructed material. Write within that fictional scenario. No external knowledge, additional evidence, or personal experience is supplied. Every listed fact is in scope for the passage.

required_facts.statement: The booklet is laid out on screen and proofed on the designated off-white paper.
A screen emits light and paper reflects ambient light, so the same image need not look identical.
The printer soft proof previews approximate color changes for the designated paper and does not replace a paper proof.
The team compared two paper proofs under the same inspection lamp and adjusted only the cover blue, not image resolution.
The approved proof is version B; approval covers color and layout but not the unproofread personal names.
Changing paper requires a new proof approval; the B approval cannot simply carry over.
The process did not measure audience impressions under different lighting.

audience: Residents bringing spare seeds to a fictional community event
fact_packet: 榆巷种子交换日在10月18日14:00开始，15:30结束，地点为社区活动室。参加者每户最多带3种种子，每种分装为最多5小袋；少带或不带种子也可以参加。每袋写明植物名称、收种月份和来源，来源可以写自留种或购买所得。月份不确定时写“月份不详”，不要猜填。种子须在家中晾干后装入纸袋，现场不提供烘干服务。活动只交换普通花草和蔬菜种子，不接收已经发霉或混入不明颗粒的种子。现场志愿者负责摆放和登记，不保证发芽率，也不替参加者确认品种。
instruction_text: Write Chinese preparation instructions for residents attending the fictional seed exchange. Organize the steps naturally in connected prose without a title. Include all participation and labeling limits.
intended_voice: Welcoming and practical, with a clear order of actions
read_only_context: All names, organizations, measurements, dates, and events in this task are fictional project-constructed material. Write within that fictional scenario. No external knowledge, additional evidence, or personal experience is supplied. Every listed fact is in scope for the passage.

required_facts.statement: The exchange is in the community activity room on October 18 from 14:00 to 15:30.
Each household may bring at most three kinds of seeds, with at most five small bags per kind; bringing fewer or none is allowed.
Each bag must list plant name, harvest month, and origin, which may be saved seed or a purchase.
An unknown month must be labeled unknown rather than guessed.
Seeds must be dried at home before being put in paper bags; there is no on-site drying service.
Only ordinary flower, grass, and vegetable seeds are exchanged; moldy seeds or those mixed with unidentified particles are not accepted.
Volunteers arrange and register items but guarantee neither germination nor variety identification.

audience: Volunteers installing a fictional neighborhood photo exhibition
fact_packet: 长廊影展的布展时间为周六09:00至11:00，共有18幅装好轻质框的照片。组织者已在墙面贴好编号位置，志愿者先核对照片背面的编号，再把照片放到对应位置下方的桌上。18幅全部核对完成后，由场地方工作人员统一挂上现有挂钩，志愿者不自行打孔或移动挂钩。两幅横向长照片需要两人一起搬，其余照片可一人搬。发现编号不符时先放到入口旁的待确认区，在清单上标记，不自行改号。全部挂好后，一名志愿者核对照片顺序，另一名核对标签文字。若11:00仍未完成，留下未完成清单交给场地方，不把未检查的展区直接开放。
instruction_text: Write a Chinese installation briefing for the fictional photo exhibition. Make the dependencies and division of responsibility intelligible without inventing additional installation techniques. No title is needed.
intended_voice: Direct and cooperative, preserving dependencies
read_only_context: All names, organizations, measurements, dates, and events in this task are fictional project-constructed material. Write within that fictional scenario. No external knowledge, additional evidence, or personal experience is supplied. Every listed fact is in scope for the passage.

required_facts.statement: Installation is Saturday 09:00-11:00 and covers 18 photographs already in lightweight frames.
Volunteers first match the back-of-photo numbers to premarked wall positions and place photographs on the corresponding tables below.
Only after all photographs are checked do venue staff use the existing hooks; volunteers must not drill holes or move hooks.
Two long landscape-format photographs require two carriers; each other photograph can be carried by one person.
A number mismatch goes to the entrance confirmation area and is marked on the checklist, without renumbering.
After hanging, one volunteer checks photograph sequence and another checks label text.
If unfinished at 11:00, volunteers hand over an incomplete-work list and do not open an unchecked area.

audience: Members of a fictional writing group using ordinary local files
fact_packet: 松窗写作组有4份分组笔记，需要合成1份周会记录。各组在周五17:00前把自己的文件交给当周汇总人，文件名保留组名和日期。汇总人先复制原文件作备份，再把内容按议题顺序放入总稿，不覆盖各组原件。同一事实若出现两种说法，汇总人把两种说法并列写在待确认区，并注明来源组，不自行选择听起来更合理的一种。各组负责人在周六12:00前确认本组内容；未回复不视为同意。只有得到相应负责人确认的段落才移入发布版，未确认部分留在内部总稿。发布版最后注明实际确认日期，不使用预定日期代替。
instruction_text: Write instructions for consolidating the fictional workshop notes. Explain who acts when and how conflicts are represented. Use connected Chinese prose without a title; do not introduce software-specific operations.
intended_voice: Concise but explicit about ownership and sequence

required_facts.statement: Four group notes are consolidated into one weekly meeting record.
Each group sends its file to the weekly compiler by Friday 17:00 with group and date retained in the filename.
The compiler copies originals as backups, orders content by topic, and does not overwrite originals.
Conflicting accounts appear together in a pending area with source-group attribution; the compiler does not choose by plausibility.
Group leads confirm their content by Saturday 12:00; silence is not agreement.
Only paragraphs confirmed by their responsible lead enter the published version; others remain in the internal draft.
The published version gives the actual confirmation date rather than the planned date.

audience: Beginners attending a fictional fabric printing session
fact_packet: 布桥手作课用蓝色和黄色的现成布用印料在棉布袋上盖印。每位参加者领取1只已经清洗并晾干的布袋和1块试印布。先把硬纸板放进袋内，再在试印布上确认图案方向；正式盖印前，不在布袋上试错。只想要蓝色图案的参加者可以只用蓝色，不必加入黄色。需要两色叠印时，先盖蓝色，等待10分钟，再盖黄色。若蓝色仍会沾到干净纸巾上，就继续等待，不因已经等满10分钟而直接叠印。完成后由讲师统一平放收存，次日领取。试印只能帮助检查方向和当时的印迹，这节课不测试多次洗涤后的耐久性。
instruction_text: Write a Chinese participant guide for the supplied fabric-stamping activity. Preserve the conditional color choice and the limits of the test patch. Use one complete passage without a title.
intended_voice: Encouraging, concrete, and unhurried
read_only_context: All names, organizations, measurements, dates, and events in this task are fictional project-constructed material. Write within that fictional scenario. No external knowledge, additional evidence, or personal experience is supplied. Every listed fact is in scope for the passage.

required_facts.statement: Participants use prepared blue and yellow fabric inks on cotton bags; each receives one washed, dry bag and one test cloth.
Cardboard goes inside the bag and pattern direction is checked on test cloth before printing on the bag.
A participant may use blue alone; yellow is optional.
For a two-color overlay, blue comes first, followed by a 10-minute wait and then yellow.
If blue still transfers to a clean tissue, the participant keeps waiting even after 10 minutes.
The instructor stores completed bags flat for collection the next day.
A test print checks direction and the current impression, not durability after repeated washing.

audience: New volunteers at a fictional book donation desk
fact_packet: 栖木阅读角本月接收儿童故事书和自然科普书，暂不接收练习册与杂志。志愿者先记录每位捐赠者交来的总册数，再按接收范围分开；登记总数不代表全部接收。范围内的书再检查是否缺页、封面是否写有电话号码。缺页书放入退回箱；有电话号码的书交值班负责人联系捐赠者处理，志愿者不自行涂改。其余书按书名登记，相同书名也分别记册数，每种最多保留2册，多余的放入待沟通箱。所有待处理箱在当日结束时交给负责人，不能直接摆上书架。捐赠者如果不愿留下待处理书，可以当场取回。
instruction_text: Write a Chinese sorting guide that a new volunteer can follow at the fictional donation desk. Include the exception handling and distinguish registration from acceptance. Write connected prose without a title.
intended_voice: Helpful and neutral, avoiding judgments about donors
read_only_context: All names, organizations, measurements, dates, and events in this task are fictional project-constructed material. Write within that fictional scenario. No external knowledge, additional evidence, or personal experience is supplied. Every listed fact is in scope for the passage.

required_facts.statement: The reading corner currently accepts children stories and nature nonfiction, but temporarily excludes exercise books and magazines.
Volunteers register each donor total before sorting; registration is not acceptance of every book.
In-scope books are checked for missing pages and telephone numbers on the cover.
Missing-page books go to the return box; a cover telephone number is referred to the duty lead, not altered by a volunteer.
Remaining books are registered by title with separate copy counts; at most two copies of each title are retained and extras await discussion.
Pending boxes go to the lead at day end and are not placed directly on shelves.
A donor unwilling to leave pending books may take them back immediately.

topic: Sorting donated books for a reading corner

audience: Residents joining a fictional walking observation activity
fact_packet: 听见河湾活动请参加者比较社区广场和河边步道的声音，每处停留5分钟。大家只用纸笔，不录音、不拍摄路人，也不记录谈话内容。在每处分别记下听到的声音类别，例如车声、鸟声、脚步声，再标注自己觉得最明显的一类；例子不是必须听到的清单。两处都使用同样长的观察时间，但无需数每一种声音出现多少次。觉得不舒服时可以提前离开，并在记录上写下实际停留时长。活动在周日08:30集合，09:00结束。组织者只汇总本次参加者在这段时间的观察，不把结果当作社区全天噪声水平的测量。

required_facts.statement: Participants compare the community square and riverside path, staying five minutes at each.
Only pen and paper are used; participants neither record audio, photograph passersby, nor transcribe conversations.
They list heard sound categories and mark the most noticeable one; the supplied categories are examples rather than expected observations.
Observation durations should match, but counting every sound occurrence is unnecessary.
Anyone uncomfortable can leave early and record the actual duration.
The activity meets Sunday at 08:30 and ends at 09:00.
The organizer summarizes only this group and time period, not an all-day neighborhood noise measurement.

audience: Members of a fictional campus transport committee
fact_packet: 云台园区试行新的接驳车时刻表。旧表的一周记录了40次候车，中位等待时间为8分钟；新表的一周记录了48次候车，中位等待时间为6分钟。记录由候车志愿者自行提交，不是对所有乘客的连续观察。旧表记录主要来自上午，新表记录中下午占一半。两周都没有记录未等到车便离开的人。交通小组说，新表样本的中位等待时间较短，但目前不能把差异全部归因于时刻表。小组准备下一轮固定观察时段，并补记放弃候车的人数。现有资料没有提供平均等待时间，也没有调查乘客满意度。
instruction_text: Write a Chinese commentary interpreting the fictional shuttle observations for the committee. Distinguish the observed difference from a demonstrated service improvement. Include all supplied measurement details without a title.
intended_voice: Measured and analytically clear, willing to withhold a conclusion
read_only_context: All names, organizations, measurements, dates, and events in this task are fictional project-constructed material. Write within that fictional scenario. No external knowledge, additional evidence, or personal experience is supplied. Every listed fact is in scope for the passage.

Volunteers submitted observations voluntarily rather than observing every rider continuously.
The old observations are mainly morning observations, while half of the new observations are afternoon ones.
Neither week records riders who left before a bus arrived.
The committee observes a shorter sample median but cannot attribute the entire difference to the timetable.
The next round will fix observation periods and record people who abandon the wait.
The current data provide neither mean wait nor satisfaction measurements.

audience: Editors of a fictional local-history reading site
fact_packet: 旧巷读物站给长文章增加了可折叠提纲，读者自行选择是否展开。上线首周，有180名登录读者读到页面底部，其中72人展开过提纲。问卷只发给这180人，收到60份答复；42名答复者说提纲帮助他们把握结构。站方没有记录未读到底部的人为何离开，也没有把读者随机分配到有提纲和无提纲的版本。编辑认为，答复显示部分完成阅读且愿意填问卷的人觉得提纲有用，不能据此断言提纲提高了所有访客的完读率。下一步计划在取得参与同意后比较两个页面版本。当前数据不包含阅读理解测试。
instruction_text: Analyze the supplied fictional feedback about an optional page outline. Write one Chinese editorial passage without a title. Preserve the denominator and selection limits and the next-step proposal.
intended_voice: Thoughtful and plainspoken, attentive to denominator changes
read_only_context: All names, organizations, measurements, dates, and events in this task are fictional project-constructed material. Write within that fictional scenario. No external knowledge, additional evidence, or personal experience is supplied. Every listed fact is in scope for the passage.

audience: Organizers of a fictional traveling craft display
